title: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, a user that holds a role with the run_collect capability could…
description: Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0 contain a vulnerability where a user with the run_collect capability can inject attacker-controlled values into Intrusion Detection data. When another user accesses the Intrusion Search dashboard and selects an affected row, the system may execute attacker-controlled Search Processing Language (SPL) commands with the permissions of the selecting user. This occurs because the Intrusion Search dashboard does not properly escape data-model field values before inserting them into drilldown searches, potentially allowing unauthorized data access and modification.
